subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the rendering style of <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>: a dreamy painterly digital illustration with soft brushstroke textures and rich saturated hues of emerald green, radiant gold and cool blue, peaceful and almost magical.
<Subject 2> is the lily pond in space: round floating green lily pads, white water lilies that glow like stars, stars and nebulae, rings of light that spread through space like ripples on still water.
<Picture 1> is the first frame of [Shot 1], showing a close slightly elevated view of a single white water lily fully open on its round green pad floating in deep blue space, its petals glowing gold from within like a small star, tiny golden sparks drifting up from its center, faint rings of light spreading around the pad, a soft emerald and violet nebula behind.
<Picture 2> is the last frame of [Shot 1], showing a low view looking up past the glowing petal tips of the white lily at the bottom edge of the frame toward a vast spiral galaxy of emerald, gold and violet light, round lily pads drifting overhead as dark silhouettes rimmed with gold, a stream of golden sparks rising toward the galaxy.

summary:

detailed_description:
The target video is a living painterly illustration in <Subject 1>: brushstroke texture stays visible as everything moves, motion is slow, gentle and dreamlike.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. Golden sparks rise from the center of the glowing lily in a slow, steady stream. The camera tilts up at a slow, steady speed in one continuous move, following the sparks upward, and the lily slides down in the frame until only its glowing petal tips remain along the bottom edge. Above, a vast spiral galaxy of emerald, gold and violet light comes into view and fills the center of the frame, turning very slowly. Round green lily pads drift across overhead as dark silhouettes against the galaxy light, like lily pads seen from under a pond, their edges rimmed with gold. The sparks keep rising toward the galaxy and fade into its glow. The camera is still tilting gently up as the shot ends on <Picture 2>. No cut or transition occurs.

overall_soundscape:
A deep, slowly swelling cosmic hum, a soft rising shimmer that follows the sparks upward.
